description.en-US: Whether confirming an order sends it straight to PURCHASE_ORDER (one_step) or through TO_APPROVE first (two_step). One row per organization, which is what the unique index enforces: two rows would make 'does this order need approval?' depend on which was read (BR 47.1).

The order total at or above which approval is required. Meaningful only when approval_mode is two_step, so it is optional rather than defaulted: a zero would read as 'approve everything', which is a different policy from 'no threshold set' (BR 47.2).
What happens to an order when it is confirmed: stay editable, or lock automatically. auto_lock sets is_locked at confirmation, which is why lock is a boolean on the order and not a status (BR 47.3).
